t: What was guaranteed for the one who leaves
a: انْتَدَبَ اللَّهُ لِمَنْ خَرَجَ فِي سَبِيلِهِ لاَ يُخْرِجُهُ إِلاَّ إِيمَانٌ بِي وَتَصْدِيقٌ بِرُسُلِي أَنْ أُرْجِعَهُ بِمَا نَالَ مِنْ أَجْرٍ أَوْ غَنِيمَةٍ
p: Intadaba-Llāhu li-man kharaja fī sabīlih, lā yukhrijuhu illā īmānun bī wa taṣdīqun bi-rusulī, an urjiʿahu bimā nāla min ajrin aw ghanīmah
m: Allah has undertaken for the one who goes out in His path, driven out by nothing but faith in Me and belief in My messengers, that He will return him with whatever he gained of reward or spoils,
